# saastarter2

> The self-aware SaaS template: an ecommerce shop that sells its own source
> code — raw HTML + Bootstrap over a declarative baas on Cloudflare Workers.

No build step: the deployed files ARE the source. View source on any page.

## Pages
- https://mahmoodkhalil57.github.io/saastarter2/  https://mahmoodkhalil57.github.io/saastarter2/products.html  https://mahmoodkhalil57.github.io/saastarter2/cart.html  https://mahmoodkhalil57.github.io/saastarter2/blog.html  https://mahmoodkhalil57.github.io/saastarter2/contact.html

## Editing
- Browser agents: https://mahmoodkhalil57.github.io/saastarter2/dev.html — with a
  saved fine-grained GitHub token, `s2devgit.enterEdit()` freezes a page so the
  DOM is the source file; mutate it, then `s2devgit.push("message")` commits.

## API
- OpenAPI: https://mizan-gpp.the-montiapple.workers.dev/v1/projects/b40546af-b19c-46ca-8661-87db12b3e85a/openapi.json
- MCP: https://mizan-gpp.the-montiapple.workers.dev/v1/projects/b40546af-b19c-46ca-8661-87db12b3e85a/mcp
